reviewerDecisionInstructions: Inspect each exact pinned release separately, including notice of externally authored graphics, images, attachments or other restricted third-party content.
Choose scope narrowly: original editorial prose and direct hyperlink, with dated release title/issuer attribution, not numerical feed extraction or rehosting.
Assess U.S. federal works and foreign publication/retention rights distinctly; do not infer international protection from U.S. public-domain policy.

Record reviewer, reviewed date, allowed media (website, newsletter, PDF, translation, archive), exclusions, decision basis and scoped receipt. A separate owner action is required to approve any usage.
Until an explicit reviewed decision and separately authorized release exist, preserve every source and publication gate as false.
